title: 第1932章 我其实也怕的这肯定不是绝路第1931章 好很好你们两个都很好
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
第1932章我其实也怕的，这肯定不是绝路
诸葛伏天深吸了一口气，然后道，“行了，你们都不要磨蹭了，赶紧做出选择吧。”
此话一出，还在吃瓜的一众男女，立时做出了选择来。
最终，除了陈稳几个人选择牧晴外，便没有其他人了。
诸葛伏天看着这一切，轻叹了一口气。
其实他也并不看好牧晴，但他还是希望有多一点人选牧晴这边的。
因为哪怕是真的遇到了危险，多一个人也能相互扶持一下。
但现在就不一样了，仅仅六个人，如果真的遇到了危险，怕会很难吧。
不行。
我必须想一个办法来平衡这次的危险。
这是他做为一大长老该负的责任。
想到这，诸葛伏天这才开口道，“这样，小山，小龙还有小冰，你们带自己的弟子出来。”
嗯？
洪山，李承龙和莫凝冰都不自主一愣。
显然，他们都没有想到诸葛伏天会这个时候点他们的名。
难不成是看牧晴那也的人少，然后就想让我们加进去？
想到这，他们的眉头不由轻拧起来。
萧不易的脸色也有些不太好看？
无论是洪山，还是李承龙和莫凝冰，那实力都是属于第一梯队的。
也就是说，除了诸葛伏天能稳压这些人一头外，其他的长老都不敢夸这个大。

如果诸葛伏天真的让这几个人加入牧晴那队，对于他来说并不是一个好消息。
在他看来，牧晴选的绝路，那死在那里就更好了。
如果有这些人加入，那就不一定了，哪怕真的是绝路。
洪山等人相视了一眼，还是带着自己的徒弟走了出来。
“我知道你们在想什么。”
诸葛伏天无奈一叹，“我不会强行让你们加入牧晴那边的。”
此话一出，洪山等人不由松了一口气。
但很快，他们又疑惑了，那诸葛伏天这么做是为了什么。
萧不易等人也不由投来目光，都在等待着诸葛伏天接下来所说的话。
诸葛伏天深吸了一口气，然后开口道，“我的想法是，你们与我一起留在原地。”
“他们两队就当是一开拓者，如果他们哪一方遇到了麻烦，我们都可以及时支援他们。”
说着，他又叹了一口气，“我们这一次进来，并不是为了争一个高低，，。”
“而是尽可能一起进来，再一起出去。”
“明白了吗？”
此话一出，众人皆是为之一震。
content_en:
Chapter 1932 I am actually afraid too, this is definitely not a dead end
Zhuge Futian took a deep breath, and then said, "Okay, don't wait any longer and make your choice quickly."
As soon as these words came out, the men and women who were still eating melons immediately made their choices.
In the end, except for Chen Wen and a few others who chose Mu Qing, there was no one else.
Zhuge Futian looked at all this and sighed softly.
In fact, he is not optimistic about Mu Qing, but he still hopes that more people will choose Mu Qing.
Because even if we are really in danger, one more person can support each other.
But it's different now. With only six people, if we really encounter danger, I'm afraid it will be difficult.
no.
I had to think of a way to balance the danger this time.
This is his responsibility as an elder.
Thinking of this, Zhuge Futian said, "This way, Xiaoshan, Xiaolong and Xiaobing, you bring your disciples out."
Huh?
Hong Shan, Li Chenglong and Mo Ningbing were all stunned.
Obviously, none of them expected that Zhuge Futian would call their names at this time.
Could it be that Mu Qing wanted us to join in because there were so few people there?
Thinking of this, their brows couldn't help but frown.
Xiao Buyi's face also looks a little unsightly?
Whether it is Hong Shan, Li Chenglong or Mo Ningbing, their strength belongs to the first echelon.
In other words, except for Zhuge Futian who can suppress these people, the other elders dare not boast about this.
If Zhuge Futian really lets these people join Mu Qing's team, it will not be good news for him.
In his opinion, it would be better to die there if Mu Qing chose the dead end.
If these people join, it won't necessarily be possible, even if it is really a dead end.
Hong Shan and others looked at each other and walked out with their apprentice.
"I know what you're thinking."
Zhuge Futian sighed helplessly, "I will not force you to join Mu Qing's side."
As soon as these words came out, Hong Shan and others couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
But soon, they wondered again why Zhuge Futian did this.
Xiao Buyi and others couldn't help but cast their gazes, waiting for what Zhuge Futian would say next.
Zhuge Futian took a deep breath, and then said, "My idea is that you stay where you are with me."
"The two teams should be regarded as pioneers. If either of them encounters trouble, we can support them in time."
As he said that, he sighed again, "We are not coming in this time to compete for the top spot."
“It’s about coming in together and going out together as much as possible.”
"Do you understand?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was shocked.
